additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0461844
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-HUSI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
RVP/T7170004940
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
Following the procedure for diagnosing a power converter issue, and after our check, as shown in the screenshot I sent, we can see that converter number 5 is faulty.
First, check the
cables attached to that converter. If they are properly connected, proceed to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This will help confirm whether the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-HU SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process

afonso-sousa@siemens.com

Thank you.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0461844-DC/Si-D/HU-[RVP / T7 17000494] Power Converter(5) Issue CRM:03042000178
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I understand that we need to do an on-site inspection regarding the faulty converter, we’ll schedule it and do it.
Please, answer my other question:
The other problem is, that sometimes the charger ignores the failing power converter, but sometimes doesn't, and the customer cannot charge the truck, see logs in scb.
In my opinion, the SichargeD charger should handle this automatically: ignore the faulty power converter and start the charging of the vehicle with reduced capacity. Is it a known issue? Maybe it's a software bug? The charger is on the latest firmware. Can we upgrade it to a firmware where this issue is corrected?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0461844-DC/Si-D/HU-[RVP / T7 17000494] Power Converter(5) Issue CRM:03042000178
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We were on-site and checked what was suggested:
Facts: customer was able to charger with 360kW 3 weeks ago (1 missing module was expected).
Last week we have noticed in the SCB that 2 pcs are failing, instead of just one...
Today on site we have noticed 3 modules missing in SCB.
On site we have swapped all the expected 3 modules with another normal operating ones.
After swap, all the modules remain on the same location, same serial numbers were indicated in the SCB as missing.
Which is strange, that the LEDs on the modules showed Orange colour in 3 cases, and orange + red in 1 case -> these modules are different from the ones indicated missing in the SCB (except TB6).
Communication cables are checked, no issue has been detected.
Please, allow to replace the power converters under warranty, and propose which modules (and how many?) we need to replace on site (please check the attached excel file, you will understand which modules we swapped with which one; also where we noticed LEDs (orange and/or red), also what serial numbers are indicated „missing” in the SCB) also under warranty.
We would like to replace the module(s), thats why it is important to identify which one (and how many) should be replaced.
Thank you for your help!
Kind regards,
Laszlo
With kind regards,
Laszlo Szilagyi
Siemens Zrt.
